title: Deterministic v1 contract snapshots
summary:
Generate and commit the installed-code v1 OpenAPI, operation, error and digest manifest
from one profile.
why:
`@plan/knowledge/research-P13-design.json` §9; D73/S35. Deterministic runtime generation without a committed
baseline cannot prove compatibility to external clients.

include:
Snapshot builder/command; canonical output; v1 OpenAPI/operations/errors/manifest;
P12 fixture consumption; repeat-generation and digest tests; build-time profile fixture.
exclude:
Tenant-effective capability snapshot; webhooks.json before P14; compatibility
verdict (P13.11); client SDK generation; timestamps/host paths.

rules:
Generator owns all `api/v1/*.json`; never hand-edit them. Exact contents/
exclusions from §9. Operations snapshot is behavioral authority; OpenAPI is projection; errors derive
from P12 fixture. Manifest hashes exact canonical bytes and includes no time/path/tenant/secret. Command
fails on dirty target unless explicit `--check` or atomic replace succeeds.
guidance:
Encode via `JsonCanonical` then pretty-print only through one deterministic helper
whose bytes are covered by test. Sort operations/errors/properties where semantic order is irrelevant.
Use a committed test profile assembled from module declarations, not live production tenant state.

validation.procedure: Generate twice into temporary directories: byte-identical
Manifest SHA-256 matches all three files; reverse module input is the same
Alter operation input changes the digest; --check passes current files and fails one-byte drift
No webhooks.json, host path, or secret
API lint, static analysis and full suite

deliverables: Generator/command, four generated v1 carriers and reproducibility/digest evidence.

result.notes: P13.10 GREEN: corex:api-snapshots writes deterministic v1 openapi, operations, errors and manifest. Repeat bytes match; --check fails one-byte drift. API pest 145/1023, phpstan 0, pint passed.
